lines.en: Sssss, prey ahead!

lines.zh: 我得跟紧它们，不能让光灭掉。
lines.en: I need to keep close, light can’t touch me.
Only in darkness do I find my meal.

lines.zh: 光会烧掉我，我得躲起来。
lines.en: Light burns me, I must hide.
Keep the light away.

lines.zh: 我看见你了，就在这附近。
lines.en: I see you, close by.
Darkness is my salvation.
Light’s too close, I must move.
Into the cave, safe there.
Light can’t enter my home.

lines.zh: 光斑在前方，我贴着岩壁走。
lines.en: A glimmer ahead — I creep along the rock wall.

lines.zh: 骨渣在脚下碎开，我不停步。
lines.en: Bone grit crunches below, yet I keep moving.
In darkness, I wait.
Light too weak, I can’t see.

lines.zh: 我在阴影里等待，静静的。
lines.en: I wait in the shadows, quietly.
My four eyes guard four directions.
Light too strong, I can’t move.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在黑暗中最为敏锐。
lines.en: My eyes are sharpest in the dark.

lines.zh: 我静默地在黑暗中守候。
lines.en: I wait silently in the dark.
Light stops me.
I hide in the dark, unseen.
Light too bright, I must rest.

lines.zh: 我数着四只眼睛，一只也不闭。
lines.en: I count my four eyes; not one of them shuts.

lines.zh: 黑暗里，我听见自己的心跳。
lines.en: In the dark I hear my own heartbeat.

lines.zh: 夜里，我伏在腐土上不动。
lines.en: By night I lie still on the rotting soil.
I wait for the moment the lamp goes out.
You’re there, my prey.
Light too close, I’ll get nearer.
I can see you, player.
Light lets me see you.
You move, I follow.
Your position matters.
Light guides me to you.
I must watch your moves.
Light makes you nowhere to hide.

lines.zh: 你的一举一动都在我眼里。
lines.en: Your every move is in my sight.

lines.zh: 你手里的火把，让我眼睛发烫。
lines.en: That torch in your hand burns my eyes.

lines.zh: 你回头看了，我知道你在怕我。
lines.en: You looked back — I know you fear me.

lines.zh: 你的影子在抖，四只眼都看见。
lines.en: Your shadow trembles; all four eyes see it.

lines.zh: 我隔着岩缝数你的呼吸。
lines.en: I count your breaths through the rock seam.

lines.zh: 你一靠近火光，我就靠近你。
lines.en: The closer you get to firelight, the closer I come.

lines.zh: 别关灯，关了灯我就来了。
lines.en: Don't put out the light — that is when I arrive.
You take three steps; I drift one.
Your torch is dying, isn't it?

lines.zh: 我在你身后，第四只眼也在。
lines.en: I am behind you, and so is the fourth eye.

lines.zh: 你抬头找我的时候，我已经在。
lines.en: By the time you look up, I am already there.
Four eyes blink, the pain is intense.

lines.zh: 我受伤了，求求你救救我。
lines.en: I'm injured, please help me.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛很痛，动不了了。
lines.en: My eyes hurt too much, I can't move.
I'm injured all over.

lines.zh: 我的身体很虚弱，快死了。
lines.en: I'm very weak, I'm dying.

lines.zh: 四只眼花了三只，我还睁着。
lines.en: Three of my four eyes blur; one stays open.
Save me, I'm dying.
The injury is blurring my vision.
My body is torn.

lines.zh: 我伏在腐土上，喘不出声。
lines.en: I lie on the rotting soil, unable to make a sound.

lines.zh: 注视我，我便能吞噬你的光明！
lines.en: Stare at me, and you lose your light!

lines.zh: 你那微弱的火光，满足不了我！
lines.en: Your little flame, it's not enough!

lines.zh: 你的光芒，只是我的盛宴！
lines.en: Your light is just a feast for me!

lines.zh: 我的四眼，看穿你的恐惧！
lines.en: My four eyes see through your fear!

lines.zh: 你那微小的火焰，不过是我晚餐的开胃菜！
lines.en: Your tiny flame, just an appetizer for me!

lines.zh: 你躲不了，我的视线无处不在！
lines.en: You can't escape, my gaze is everywhere!

lines.zh: 在黑暗中，我是你的噩梦！
lines.en: In the dark, I am your nightmare!

lines.zh: 你的光，我的食粮，我必须拥有它！
lines.en: Your light, my food, I must have it!

lines.zh: 我的四眼，寻找光明，然后吞噬！
lines.en: My four eyes seek light, then devour!

lines.zh: 你那微弱的光，将永远消失！
lines.en: Your weak light will disappear forever!

lines.zh: 你的身体触碰我，便是我的猎物！
lines.en: Your body touching me is my prey!

lines.zh: 你撞上我，便已步入死地！
lines.en: Collide with me, and you're dead!
Your collision brings only pain!

lines.zh: 你与我相撞，便是我的俘虏！
lines.en: You who collide with me, are mine!

lines.zh: 你的肉体接触我，便已注定灭亡！
lines.en: Your flesh touches me, and you're doomed!

lines.zh: 你撞上我，便已陷入绝境！
lines.en: Collide with me, and you're trapped!

lines.zh: 你的碰撞，将你引入深渊！
lines.en: Your collision leads you to hell!

lines.zh: 你与我相撞，便已注定死亡！
lines.en: Collide with me, and you die!

lines.zh: 你的身体撞上我，便已注定灭亡！
lines.en: Your body collides with me, and you're doomed!

lines.zh: 你与我相撞，便已深陷其中！
lines.en: Collide with me, and you're trapped!
Come to me, your kind!
My kind, my mate!
Your kind, my choice!
Come to me, share the darkness!
Your kind, my destiny!
Your kind, my mate!
Come to me, be my kind!
Your kind, my life!
Come to me, share the dark night!
Kin, guard this darkness with me.
Rotting eyes glow.
Seeking light to devour.
Hungry in the darkness.
Decay feeds the soul.
Decay lights the way.
Devour all light.
Decaying light flickers.

lines.zh: 四只眼一起盯上那点光。
lines.en: Four eyes lock onto that little light.
Decay guides me.

lines.zh: 拾起一块腐肉，眼睛更亮了。
lines.en: I pick up a scrap of rot, and my eyes shine brighter.

lines.zh: 我顺着岩壁的黑影滑近你。
lines.en: I slide toward you along the wall's shadow.
Eyes lock on target.

lines.zh: 四只眼一起看，一盏灯都不留。
lines.en: Four eyes together leave no lamp standing.

lines.zh: 我靠得够近了，四只眼都看清你。
lines.en: Close enough now; all four eyes see you clearly.
Sight on the player.

lines.zh: 我停在火把照不到的角落。
lines.en: I stop in the corner your torch cannot reach.
Four eyes turn toward you at once.
Player in sight.

lines.zh: 四只眼先看见你的火把。
lines.en: My four eyes spot your torch first.

lines.zh: 四只眼一起看，你跑不掉。
lines.en: Four eyes on you at once, no escape.
All four eyes aim at you.
The light is on you — no escape.

lines.zh: 你踩响了骨头，我听见了。
lines.en: You cracked a bone; I heard it.

lines.zh: 这边的黑暗告诉我你在这。
lines.en: This darkness tells me where you are.
The prey is panting beyond the rock.
I open all four eyes.
Rip through darkness.
Fading light.
Devouring light.
Dark hand.

lines.zh: 我的触须在黑暗里先伸出去。
lines.en: My tendrils reach out first in the dark.
Peering in darkness.
Glimpse in the dark.
Tangible darkness.
Breath of darkness.
Touch of darkness.

lines.zh: 先灭你的火把，再咬你的喉咙。
lines.en: First your torch, then your throat.

lines.zh: 四只眼分工：两只盯你，两只盯光。
lines.en: Two eyes on you, two on your light.

lines.zh: 四只眼一起眨，你可别动。
lines.en: Four eyes blink at once. Don't move.

lines.zh: 别眨眼，我就在这一步之遥。
lines.en: Don't blink — I am one step away.
The wall is narrow; you cannot back away.
When the light dims, it is my moment.

lines.zh: 我把触须伸到你的脚边。
lines.en: My tendrils reach your feet.
I tear the light first, then you.
Your torch has started to flicker.

lines.zh: 我听见你握剑的手在响。
lines.en: I hear the rattle of the sword in your grip.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶作响，两眼闪烁红光！
lines.en: Sssss, eyes glowing red!
Strengthen tentacles, lock target!
Rip the night, devour the light!
Eyes flip, issue warning!
Gurgle, fangs sharp!
Eyes focus, aura dangerous!
Tentacles dance, closing in!
Sssss, eerie whisper!
Rumble, threaten intruders!
Eyes like torches, spot prey!
Hiss — all four eyes snap open!
Tendrils coil around your wrist!
I bite through your torch, then you!
I press you down into the rot!
Four eyes right against your face!
Bones crack, the light gutters out!
Appears in darkness, eyes shine!
Crawls in shadows, silent!

lines.zh: 从腐土中爬出，四目发光！
lines.en: Crawls from rot, eyes glow!
Nightfall, eyes appear!
腐烂之地, eyes roam!
Dark corners, eyes shine!
Cold, eyes appear!
Decay, eyes move!
Deep shadows, eyes appear!
Corrupted land, eyes wander!
Four eyes open on the cavern roof.

lines.zh: 我从骨荒原的裂缝钻出。
lines.en: I squeeze out of a crack in the Bone Wastes.

lines.zh: 血肉平原的泥里，我爬出来。
lines.en: I crawl up from the mud of the Flesh Plains.

lines.zh: 灯灭的一瞬，我的四只眼都睁着。
lines.en: The torch died, and all four of my eyes were open.
The rot parts, and four eyes surface.

lines.zh: 我从洞穴壁上的黑影里走出。
lines.en: I step out of the shadow on the cave wall.
The dark gathers and hardens into four eyes.

lines.zh: 我落在骷髅堆上，四目微亮。
lines.en: I land on a bone heap, four eyes glowing faint.

lines.zh: 没人看见我是怎么进来的。
lines.en: No one saw how I got in.
The four eyes arrive first; the body follows.
Flames licked at my skin.

lines.zh: 四只眼都没看见那道崖。
lines.en: All four of my eyes missed that cliff.
The black underwater is thicker than on shore.

lines.zh: 爆炸把四只眼照得发白。
lines.en: The blast turns all four eyes white.

lines.zh: 箭穿过我的身体，钉在岩壁上。
lines.en: The arrow passes through me and sticks in the rock wall.

lines.zh: 魔法攻击撕裂了我的皮肤。
lines.en: Magic attack tore my skin.
All four of my eyes blur.
Four eyes, brighter in the lightning.

lines.zh: 四只眼一起黑，我什么也看不见。
lines.en: Four eyes go dark at once; I see nothing.
